verdict.rationale: Convertio's developer portal lists an official CLI ('Our Command Line Interface') alongside an API-key-based API, so a first-party command-line conversion path exists. The evidence is only a single heading-level mention, with no command syntax, one-line example, or scripting/CI guidance. Missing for 10: documented one-line conversion command syntax, examples of use in scripts/CI (auth via API key, exit codes, non-interactive mode), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented command converts a file in one line, usable from scripts and CI
